objective: Phase 1F: What-If Simulator - Isolated scenario simulation with zero database mutation, baseline vs scenario comparison, interactive levers, and delta calculations
acceptance_criteria: Scenario schemas and service supporting scenario creation, event shifting (date/amount overrides), and ad-hoc hypothetical expenses/inflows
Run both baseline and scenario through the exact same pure deterministic forecast engine
Calculate day-by-day balance delta, minimum balance/date, and shortage status resolution
Strict isolation invariant: verify that simulating scenarios causes ZERO mutations to actual customer, supplier, transaction, or business records
API endpoints: POST /api/v1/scenarios, GET /api/v1/scenarios, POST /api/v1/scenarios/{id}/events, POST /api/v1/scenarios/{id}/forecast
Interactive UI in SimulatorPage.tsx with dynamic baseline vs scenario comparison charts, event shift toggles, and instant visual impact
Automated unit and API tests proving correctness and zero database mutation
Frontend build compiles cleanly with TypeScript strict mode

evidence.pytest: 31 passed in 0.68s (test_scenarios.py, test_alerts.py, test_api.py, test_forecast.py, test_ledger.py, test_money.py, test_suppliers_expenses.py)

non_goals: Never persist scenario shifts to actual customer khata or supplier bills (purely isolated)
